g.text: Three ways to smooth a command, and what each one costs

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: The kernel is the same shape throughout. Only where it sits in time changes.

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #2f6f9e; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: sample that has not happened yet

g.text: weights decay into the past. The centre of mass sits behind now,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: and that is exactly the phase lag.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: The centre of mass sits about a step behind. Costs 25 points of motion (Section 5.3).

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4a4a4a

font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: symmetric weights, so no phase distortion, but they are centred

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: on a sample that is already two steps old.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: 40 ms of added latency. Falls at speed, up to every episode (Section 5.5).

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4a4a4a

font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: symmetric weights centred on now. The right half does not exist yet,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: so a small per-joint model estimates it.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: No lag and no latency. Bounded by how predictable the command is.
